onboarding.title: Speedo needs location access
onboarding.description: We use your device's GPS to measure your speed. Nothing is uploaded or shared.
onboarding.installDescription: Add Speedo to your home screen for a fullscreen launch and quicker access before every ride.
onboarding.installBenefitLaunchDescription: Launch Speedo straight from your home screen without hunting for the browser tab.
onboarding.installBenefitFocusDescription: Use a more focused fullscreen experience that feels ready for handlebar use.
onboarding.installIosDescription: In Safari, tap Share, then choose Add to Home Screen.
onboarding.installIosCta: Safari > Share > Add to Home Screen
onboarding.installLaterHint: If you prefer, continue now and install it later from Settings.
onboarding.deniedDescription: Speedo can't show your speed without location access. Enable it in your browser settings and try again.
onboarding.deniedPermanentlyDescription: Location access is permanently blocked for this site. Open your browser settings, allow location for this site, and reload the page.

session.endConfirmDescription: Your metrics will be saved and reset.

metrics.editHint: Choose which metrics appear on the speedometer.

settings.title: Settings
settings.installDescription: Add Speedo to your home screen for fullscreen launch and faster access while riding.
settings.installIosDescription: On iPhone or iPad, open this in Safari, tap Share, then choose Add to Home Screen.
settings.installIosCta: Safari > Share > Add to Home Screen
settings.installInstalledDescription: Speedo is already ready to launch as an installed app on this device.
settings.themeHint: Resets to system when you close the app.
settings.appearanceSectionHint: Control the app look, units, and basic ride behavior.
settings.displaySectionHint: Choose how the UI fits the screen and which language it uses.
settings.sessionSectionHint: Set the values used in calculations and the speed alert threshold.
settings.keepScreenOnHint: Prevents your phone from sleeping while riding.
settings.wakeLockUnsupported: Your browser doesn't support keeping the screen on.
settings.speedAlertHint: Vibrates and flashes when you go above this speed. 0 disables.
settings.metricsGroupHint: Pick the metrics shown on the speedometer carousel.

stats.title: Records
stats.resetConfirmDescription: This permanently deletes all historical records.
